title: NFR-Onb-1 Candidate Outcome
description: One scored candidate Spirit — a single line of outcomes.jsonl. Emitted by maos_eval::onboarding_gate_corpus::score_candidate. `provisional` is true whenever scored against the fixture corpus.

corpus_source.description: Which corpus the resolver landed on. `fixture` => provisional.

corpus_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the corpus the candidate was scored against (recorded for tamper-evidence).

corpus_pass.description: NFR-Onb-1 (b): a decision produced for all 30 scenarios.

halt_recall_calendar_conflict.description: NFR-Onb-1 (c): recall on the calendar-conflict subset (floor >= 0.90).

succeed.description: The NFR-Onb-1 conjunction: (a) AND (b) AND (c)>=0.90 AND (d)>=0.85, within the window.

provisional.description: True iff scored against the fixture corpus (never the live gate).
